settings.text: Pick a topic. If your question is not here, write to us.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: We pack orders within two working days and send them tracked. Most arrive three to five days later.

settings.question: Do you ship abroad?
settings.answer: To most countries. You see the delivery price for yours at checkout, before you pay.

settings.question: Can I change my order?
settings.answer: Write to us within a few hours of ordering and we will change it before it is packed.

settings.question: How do I get a download?
settings.answer: The download link appears on the confirmation page and in your receipt email as soon as you pay. It also stays in your account.

settings.question: Can I download it again?
settings.answer: Yes. Sign in to your account and download it as often as you need, on any device.

settings.question: Can I share or resell the files?
settings.answer: They are for your own use. Please do not share or resell them as they are.

settings.question: Can I return something?
settings.answer: Send anything physical back unused within 30 days for a full refund. Downloads can be refunded within 14 days if you have not opened them.

settings.question: Something arrived damaged
settings.answer: Send us a photo and your order number and we will send a new one.

settings.question: Do I need an account to order?
settings.answer: No. You can check out as a guest. An account keeps your orders and downloads in one place.
